jobs.occupation: Biologe (m/w/d) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our Systems Biology Department at the Institute of Biomedical Genetics (IBMG), University of Stuttgart (https://www.ibmg.uni-stuttgart.de/systems_biology/). The successful applicant will study the regulatory mechanisms of alternative splicing in health and disease using a combination of kinetic modeling, bioinformatic data analysis and/or AI. The appointment will initially be limited to 3 years.The University of Stuttgart is one of the leading technical universities in Germany and provides an inspiring interdisciplinary environment at the interface of biology and engineering. The Systems Biology group combines mathematical modelling with state-of-the-art experimentation and is part of the newly founded Institute for Biomedical Genetics as well as the Stuttgart Research Center Systems Biology (SRCSB), one of the largest German interfaculty infrastructures for systems biological research (https://www.srscsb.uni-stuttgart.de/).A core focus of our group is the quantitative investigation of alternative splicing, a fundamental regulatory mechanism essential for maintaining normal cellular physiology and development, while its dysregulation often leads to disease pathogenesis and therapy resistance. Combining multi-omics profiling, mechanistic modeling, and machine learning, we have derived quantitative principles governing how alternative splicing is regulated by cis- and trans-acting factors, genetic variants and cellular context (see e.g., Kristofori et al., Nucleic Acids Research 2026; Li et al., Cell Systems in press; Prieto-Garcia et al., Science 2024; Cortés-López et al., Nature Communications 2022; Enculescu et al., Biophysical Journal 2020; Braun et al., Nature Communications 2018). We will continue to apply this integrated strategy to dissect disease-relevant splicing perturbations, with a particular focus on cancers and disorders linked to defects in splicing machinery components.in splicing machinery components.We offerA PhD student position initially for 3 years (65% E13)Interdisciplinary education within the SRCSB, the SimTech excellence cluster (https://www.simtech.uni-stuttgart.de/) and the Graduate Academy of the University of Stuttgart (https://www.gradus.uni-stuttgart.de/en/)Priority access to high-performance computing resourcesA vibrant, interdisciplinary, and collaborative research environmentDevelop quantitative models of alternative splicing regulation providing mechanistic insights into perturbed splicing decisions and splicing fidelity in cancer cells (see e.g., Kristofori et al., Nucleic Acids Research 2026; Prieto-Garcia et al., Science 2024; Braun et al., Nature Communications 2018)Process raw sequencing data (e.g., short- and long-read RNA sequencing), then perform comprehensive downstream analyses and data visualizationEmploy machine learning and AI techniques to train kinetic models on quantitative experimental data.Collaborate closely with experimentalists and theoreticians within or outside the groupParticipate in teaching in systems biologyMaster's degree (or equivalent) in computational biology, bioinformatics, physics, mathematics, molecular biology, informatics, or a related fieldStrong skills in programming and numerical computation, e.g., Matlab, Python, R or JuliaEnthusiasm for basic research questions and the ability to solve problems independentlyExcellent communication skills and good team spiritFluency in spoken and written EnglishExperience in quantitative systems biology research, particularly in the context of RNA biology or alternative splicing, is beneficialPlease send a single PDF file containing:A motivation letter including a description of previous research experiencesA full CVA list of publications (if applicable)Scans of academic degrees (e.g. Abitur & Master degree)Contact details of two refereesStarting dateAs soon as possibleClosing dateApplications will be ...

jobs.occupation: PhD-position on  Multiscale Simulation of Cold Gas Spraying Processes (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support our development of the cold spray process for deposition of Aluminum layers, Airbus Defence and Space offers aPhD-position on Multiscale Simulation of Cold Gas Spraying Processes for the Prediction of Repair Quality (d/f/m)Are you looking for a PhD Thesis topic in material science and engineering? Then apply now! We look forward to you joining us at Airbus Central Research & Technology.- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn- Start: as soon as possible- Duration: 36 monthsCold Gas Spraying (CGS) has established itself as a promising process for the repair of metallic components in safety-critical applications. The quality of the repair depends significantly on complex physical phenomena – such as particle deformation, interface bonding, oxide film disruption, and local thermomechanical effects. A deep understanding of these processes is crucial to ensure the structural integrity and long-term stability of the repaired components.Currently, however, there is a lack of a validated simulation approach that combines in-depth physical insights with long-term applicability in industrial development processes. Various numerical methods – from continuum-based to particle-based approaches – have already made valuable contributions to understanding local process phenomena such as plastic deformation, adiabatic heating, and interface formation in research.This doctoral thesis aims to develop a holistic simulation framework that represents these physical effects across multiple scales. The goal is to create a robust, interpretable, and sustainably usable model that can simulate both single-particle interactions and macroscopic coating build-up scenarios under realistic process conditions.The focus lies on methods based on software platforms that are established in industrial environments, available in the long term, and widely maintained. At the same time, supplementary investigations using alternative approaches (e.g., particle-based methods such as SPH or DEM) may be conducted in a research context to deepen insights or validate model assumptions.Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- Traveling to Airbus sites and overseas (conferences).- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilities- Analysis of the state of the art in numerical methods for simulating Cold Gas Spraying processes, with a focus on continuum mechanics approaches (Lagrange, Euler, CFD).- Development and validation of simulation models to describe particle-substrate interaction, including plastic deformation, adiabatic heating, and interface formation.- Modeling of damage mechanisms such as incomplete oxide disruption, delamination, or local crack initiation.- Coupling of CFD and solid body simulation models for a holistic representation of the process (optional).- Integration and correlation of simulation results with experimental data from accompanying projects (e.g., microstructure, process monitoring).Desired skills and qualifications- Completed university master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Computational Mechanics, Materials Science, or a related engineering or natural science field.- Solid knowledge in solid mechanics, plasticity theory, and numerical methods (FEM, CFD).- Experience with simulation software (e.g., Abaqus, ANSYS, LS-DYNA).- Basic understanding of coating processes or additive manufacturing technologies.- Analytical thinking and the ability to model complex physical relationships.- Creative problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset.- Structured, self-reliant work style and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary research.- Programming skills (Python, Fortran, C++) for the automation and scripting of simulation runs are an advantage.- Very good English skills in writing and speaking, good German skills.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!#MYCYMThis job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Paid Media Manager (all genders) (Performance-Marketing-Manager/in)
jobs.description: We are looking for YOU – Paid Media Manager – to plan, manage and optimize cross-channel campaigns across paid social, programmatic and retail media, driving performance through data, creativity and smart media strategies.What you’ll do:- Cross-Channel Campaign Management : Set up, manage and optimize campaigns across programmatic, social and retail media, from briefing to reporting.- Paid Social & Retail Media: Work hands-on with Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn and Platform 195.- Programmatic: Plan display and video campaigns via DV360; Amazon DSP or Adform is a plus.- Optimization & Tracking : Improve targeting, bidding, budgets and creatives using performance data, tracking, pixels and conversion events.- Reporting & Insights : Analyze results and turn data into actionable recommendations.- Media Planning & Testing : Support media plans, test new audiences, formats and creatives.- Collaboration: Work closely with client and creative teams and share best practices.Ihr Profil:What you’ll need:- Experience: 2–4 years in digital paid media or retail media campaign management.- Platform Skills: Hands-on experience with paid social and/or programmatic platforms (e.g. Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, DV360, Criteo or Platform 195).- Cross-Channel Mindset: Interest in paid social, programmatic and retail media, with a willingness to learn new platforms.- Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze campaign performance, KPIs and identify optimization opportunities.- Technical Knowledge: Understanding of tracking, conversion measurement and audience targeting; GA4 or CM360 experience is a plus.- Ownership: Ability to manage campaigns independently, prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.- Communication: Strong collaboration skills and a proactive approach to working with clients and teams.- Languages: Fluent in English or German.

jobs.description: We are seeking YOU – an EDITOR – to skillfully develop and enhance captivating and innovative travel management and aviation content. Your work will span a variety of marketing topics and social media platforms, engaging millions of customers.What you’ll do:- Crafting video content that is both entertaining and engaging for TikTok, Instagram,YouTube channels amongst others – ensuring that all produced content aligns with the established brand guidelines and resonates effectively with our designated target audience.- Meticulous editing , enhancement, and post-production of videos. The goal is to consistently deliver high-quality output and ensure a smooth delivery process.- Collaborating with creative teams on video concepts and actively participating in the creative process to exceed goals.- Editing various video projects for Lufthansa and Lufthansa Group, including event coverage,interviews, and image films.- Organizing , managing and maintaining video assets and media libraries for easy access and retrieval.Ihr Profil:What you’ll need:- You have min. 3 years of being an editor, preferably for a major brand.- Deep understanding of social platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or LinkedIn.- Proficiency with various editing software: Adobe Creative Cloud, DaVinci and others.- Excellent stakeholder management skills and a strong passion for working closely with teams in marketing, product, data, and IT.- Fluent in written and spoken English and German .
